Estimate log2 fold change of sgRNA counts between arbitrary conditions

Source: R/hit_detection.R
estimate_fold_change.Rd

Normalizes raw sgRNA counts to CPM and computes log2 fold changes for any set of condition pairs specified via a comparisons table. Replicate columns are resolved through the samplesheet and collapsed either by averaging CPM before computing FC, or by computing per-replicate FC and then averaging.

Usage

estimate_fold_change(
  counts = NULL,
  samplesheet = NULL,
  comparisons = NULL,
  replicate_method = c("mean_cpm_then_fc", "per_replicate_fc"),
  pseudo_count = 1,
  output_dir = NULL,
  output_prefix = "crisprFlow",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  control_pattern = "NEG_CTRL"
)

Arguments

counts

A data frame with columns sgRNA, Gene, and one column per sample whose names match those derived from the samplesheet.

samplesheet

A data frame with at least columns sample_label and condition. An optional replicate column drives the mapping from condition to count columns.

comparisons

A data frame with columns numerator, denominator, and label defining which condition pairs to compare and the prefix used for the output FC columns.

replicate_method

How to handle multiple replicates per condition. "mean_cpm_then_fc" (default) averages CPM across replicates first, then computes a single log2FC. "per_replicate_fc" computes log2FC for each replicate pair (matched when counts are equal, all-pairwise otherwise) and reports the mean; a _log2FC_sd column is also added when more than one pair exists.

pseudo_count

Pseudo-count added before taking log2 ratios to avoid log(0) (default 1).

output_dir

Directory where output TSV files are written.

output_prefix

Prefix for the output file names (default "crisprFlow").

overwrite

If FALSE (default) and output files already exist, they are read and returned without recomputing.

control_pattern

Pattern identifying negative-control sgRNAs; not used in the computation but retained for consistency with the rest of the package API.

Value

A named list with elements per_sgRNA and per_gene. Each is a data frame containing mean CPM columns for every referenced condition, log2FC columns (and optionally SD columns) for every comparison, and — for per_gene — values averaged across the sgRNAs targeting each gene.

Details

The samplesheet must contain at least sample_label and condition columns. If a replicate column is present, count column names are expected to follow the pattern <sample_label>_<replicate> (e.g. Bottom_B1); otherwise just <sample_label> is used.

When only a single replicate exists for either condition in a comparison, replicate_method is ignored and the single-column CPM value is used directly.
